extracted text: The materials used were commercial Al alloys 6063 and 6082. The alloys were solution treated at 530°C for 30 min, quenched in water at room temperature and aged at 190°C for 0–200 h. The specific aging conditions selected for testing were: 160°C for 1 hour (underaged - UA) and 160°C for 64 hours (peak aged - PA) for 6063; 160°C for 1 hour (underaged - UA) and 160°C for 24 hours (peak aged - PA) for 6082.

UTS = ultimate tensile strength (MPa)
El = elongation (%)
S = fatigue strength at the number of cycles to failure (MPa)
UA = underaged condition
PA = peak aged condition
